content: {"praised": ["Serpent and the Rainbow is an award‑winning suspense film.", "Phantasm 2 is enjoyable and worth multiple viewings.", "Funhouse is entertaining enough for casual viewing.", "Bill Pullman delivers a stunning performance in the voodoo thriller.", "The films offer a mix of horror, suspense, and occasional humor."], "criticized": ["Three of the four movies are B‑quality and not scary.", "The films are predictable and lack convincing suspense.", "Acting is often silly and unconvincing.", "Strippers dancing scenes feel gratuitous and off‑tone.", "Overall horror elements are weak and underdeveloped."]}
